description: Mandatory boundary test (Section 27, 'NSW threshold'): $1.2m annual Australian wages boundary. Org's cumulative NSW wages were $1,150,000 before this employee's $100,000 contribution this period, crossing the $1,200,000 threshold mid-period. annual(1,250,000) = 0.0545*(1,250,000-1,200,000) = 2725.00; annual(1,150,000) = 0 (below threshold). Period liability = 2725.00 - 0 = 2725.00. Employer-liability-only (AU-D05) -- never reduces employee net pay.
source: ZP-TAX-AU-2026-27-001 v1.0 Section 15/17 (NSW: $1,200,000 annual threshold, 5.45%, effective 1 Jul 2026) and Section 27.
